cherished-worlds:
Cherished Worlds is a mod that adds the ability to favorite/pin/bookmark certain worlds.

When installed, empty star icons will appear next to every world on the select screen. Players can bookmark worlds by clicking on the star next to the world icon.

Bookmarking worlds will force them to always show up at the top of the world selection list and removes the ability to delete them until they are unmarked. Players can bookmark as many worlds as they want. If there are multiple bookmarked worlds, they will internally be ordered by last played date.

 This mod is client-side only.

An overhaul of the main End Island where the dragon fight takes place! 
 Obsidian pillars, End gateways, the spawn platform, and the portal itself in the middle of the island have all been redesigned. Additionally, the dragon no longer spawns from the start - instead, it will be summoned once a player gets close to the bell tower in the center. 
 To resummon the dragon, the 4 crystals no longer go right next to the portal. Instead, you'll see 4 bedrock blocks on the floor inside the tower, one in each directional wing of the building. The crystals can be placed on these 4 blocks to start summoning the dragon again. That being said, we do actually still support vanilla crystal summoning positions, to avoid confusing players who aren't familiar with the mod. 
 The dragon's AI itself is unchanged.

Cull Less Leaves

Cull Less Leaves skips rendering of inner leaf layers, improving performance.

 Performance 

In a worst-case scenario, overlooking a mangrove swamp, this mod can
have up to a 30% performance increase (measured on low-end hardware).

Instead of leaving just the outer layer of leaves, Cull Less Leaves also renders a certain amount
of layers defined in the config.

 Works best with Sodium 

 Why not just use Cull Leaves?

Cull Leaves only renders the outermost layer of leaves, which can look
quite ugly (see fast culling in image below), but Cull Leaves improves
performance more than Cull Less Leaves .

 Comparison

 

 

Sodium Configuration

 

Mod Menu Configuration

wits:
WITS (What Is This Structure?)

WITS is a neat small command mod that can work on both single player worlds and on servers! All this mod does is add a new command called /wits . Run that command and it'll print out the registry names of all structures at the exact spot you are standing at. That's it!
 

Putting this mod on a server will grant all clients the ability to use this base /wits command. Including vanilla clients!

Operators or Server Owners can add a dimension and coordinate parameter to the /witsop command to get names of structures at any location in any dimension. Non-operators will not be able to use this command with those extra parameters. Thus keeping this mod pretty balanced for players.
 

 

 NOTE: Not every build you see in mods are a structure and thus, will not be detectable by this command. Example are vanilla's dungeons and desert wells which are features.

Dark Doppelganger

A multi-phase boss fight for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge) and 1.21.1 (NeoForge), built on Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks.

The Dark Doppelganger is a spellcaster that copies whoever summons it: their look, their gear and their weapon. It calls in minions, adapts to how you fight and gets more dangerous as the fight goes on. It's meant for late-game players, alone or in a group.

 The Fight

The boss fights in three phases:

- Phase 1: Spells and melee attacks.
- Phase 2: More aggressive, with new spell combinations.
- Final phase: Summons minions often and drains life. Expect constant pressure.

Knock it into the void and it teleports back. The fight has its own music and boss bar, and it's built for several players at once.

On 1.21.1 the boss also has an intro cutscene and voice lines, and it taunts you during the fight.

jasione:
Jasione

 Overview

Jasione is an optimization mod that reduces memory allocation (GC pressure).

The Java compiler generates, for each enum class, a values() method that can be used to retrieve all enum values as an array. This method clones the array before returning it, ensuring that callers of this method can safely mutate the array without affecting other callers. This, however, incurs a performance cost. When invoked in hot paths, these small memory allocations accumulate and increase GC pressure.

Jasione addresses this issue by redirecting the values() calls that do not mutate the returned array to use a cache, eliminating the cloning overhead and the memory allocation. For details on how this is implemented safely, see to the "Technical Details" section below.

 Configuration

optipainting-reloaded:
OptiPainting Reloaded

 What's this mod do?

This mod optimizes the rendering of paintings by not rendering the sides of the painting that are never visible.

 How's it optimized?

If you have a look at a painting, you'll notice that on the sides there is a 2px indented frame,
so it sticks out from the wall. In vanilla, these faces are rendered for every single block that the painting is made of.
This is a waste of resources, as the inner faces are never visible. This mod fixes that by not rendering these faces.

This may seem like a small optimization, but these tiny faces are equivalent to the full block face, so:

- Front - 4 vertices
- Back - 4 vertices
- ~~Top - 4 vertices~~
- ~~Bottom - 4 vertices~~
- ~~Left - 4 vertices~~
- ~~Right - 4 vertices~~

Makes a total of 24 vertices per block on vanilla. And 8 vertices per block on OptiPainting.

 That's a 66% reduction in vertices! 

-

OptiPainting扩展 这是什么模组做什么？ 这个模组优化了绘画的渲染，不渲染绘画的侧面。 它是如何优化的？ 如果你看一幅画，你会注意到在侧面有一个2 px的缩进框架， 所以它从墙上伸出来。在原版中，这些面是为构成这幅画的每一个单独的方块渲染的。 这是一种资源的浪费，因为内部的面孔是永远不可见的。这个模组修复，不渲染这些面孔。 这看起来像是一个小的优化，但这些微小的面相当于完整的方块面，所以： - 前4个顶点 - 后4顶点 - ~~前4个顶点~~ - ~~底部4个顶点~~ - ~~左-4顶点~~ - ~~右- 4个顶点~~ 在vanilla上使每个方块总共有24个顶点。在OptiPainting上使每个方块有8个顶点。 顶点减少了66%！ -

protect-mobs-from-daylight:
About
This mod, as the name suggests, aims to prevent mobs from being affected by daylight, that is, not burning under the sun.

 Client or Server Side?
It's needed only server-side .

 Can I add this mod to my modpack?
Sure.

 What is the difference with Mob Sunscreen?

The actual difference is tick performance. Mob Sunscreen mod tries to clear fire on every tick (20 ticks = 1 second) on each mob while the game tries to burn them under the sun (check here). This behavior makes tick performance worse. But this is unnecessary because Minecraft already provides a clean way to do this. Protect Mobs From Daylight mod implements this way by turning off the mobs' burning under the sun. For more information, you can check the mentioned code here.

Supplemental Patches enables users to create custom shaders for modded blocks, entities, items, particles, etc,
through a resource-pack. The mod by default, comes with a built-in resource pack which supports many popular mods.

- A cool fog effect based on the effect from Doom and Gloom

- Fixed rendering of item shaders when displayed on block entities (e.g. Supplementari

shieldstun:
Shield Stun (Fabric)

Server-side Fabric mod that adds Paper's shield stunning.

Since 1.11.2 a blocked hit runs a full damage tick, handing the defender invulnerability frames and swallowing the follow-up that used to launch them (MC-268147). This mod skips that tick.

It matches Paper's skip-vanilla-damage-tick-when-shield-blocked . Skipping the tick was originally a Paper bug, but players got used to stunning with it.

 Configuration

The config file is located at config/shieldstun.json .
 json
{
 "enable stuns": true
}
 

 Commands and permissions

 Command Permission Description 
 --------------------- ------------------------------ -------------------- 
 /shieldstun everyone About info 
 /shieldstun reload shieldstun.reload (or op 3) Reloads the config 
 /shieldstun status shieldstun.status Get stun status 
 /shieldstun enable shieldstun.enable (or op 3) Enable the mod 
 /shieldstu

lag-free:
Lag Free

 What does the mod do?
Lag Free aims to reduce lag on Minecraft servers making the experience better for players and make hosting easier for server owners. The mod also adds a layer of protection from lag machines made from snowballs, arrows and ender pearls.

 How does it work?
In the config, located at world/serverconfig/lag free-config.toml , you can specify a timer in seconds that defines every how often a clear lag happens.

By default, lag clears delete every item on the ground. In the config, you can also optionally choose to make it remove every Minecart and Armor Stand, but these may make farms and certain redstone mechanics involving them unusable.

Worldgen Patches

This mod aims to patch some minor issues/quirks with world generation. Currently, this includes the following fixes:
- The steep surface rule (which in vanilla gives Jagged Peaks stone faces) now affects all directions, not just the north and east-facing sides.
- Snow layers correctly generate both below and on trees.

Tacz: Sound Attracts Zombies is a lightweight addon that bridges the gap between the realistic firearms of the Tacz (Timeless and Classics Guns) mod and the enhanced zombie AI of Zombie Awareness. This mod creates tension and risk-reward gameplay by making every shot matter—because in a world overrun by the undead, noise is a death sentence.

How It Works:
When you fire any gun from the Tacz mod, the sound generates an in-game event that triggers Zombie Awareness's "Feral Sense" system. Nearby zombies will instantly detect the gunshot and investigate the source, regardless of line of sight. The louder the gunshot, the more attention it draws.

This mod modifies the way the Fishing Rod bug works so it's easier to use.

In Vanilla Minecraft you can teleport anywhere by building an Ender Pearl Stasis Chamber on a Chunk Border, you do this by placing a Fishing Rod on a Pressure Plate and then unload that Chunk. This way the server doesn't know you still have a Fishing Bobber attached to your Fishing Rod and now you can use that Fishing Rod at anytime to refresh it causing the Stasis Chamber to activate.

The problem with this is that if you leave and rejoin the bobber is immediately despawned. This mod fixes that by manually keeping the pressure plate activated when clicked on with a Fishing Rod instead of using the Bobber. This way you can store the Fishing Rod anywhere, leave and rejoin as much as you like and when you use the Fishing Rod again it will always activate.

MineMention is a mention mod for the chat so you can specify who should get your messages better.

whenever you type an @ you'll get autocompletion for your mentions:

 

MineMention has three builtin Groups you can mention but other mods can easily add more:

 @everyone mentions every player on the server.

A performance mod for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric, JDK 25). Java handles integration and mixins; native Rust does the heavy per-tick math where crossing the JNI boundary actually pays. Server-side compatible: install on a server, players don't need it.

 Hoppers (default on): extract loops skip drained slots, up to ~85% cheaper on partially-emptied chests. Opt-in hopper highway multiplies chain throughput ~3x for storage systems.

Video games can only provide audiovisual sensory stimulation, not taste (at least for now). As a result, a large number of food items end up as mere milestones, novelties, or decorations. Taste Fatigue aims to encourage players to mass-produce a variety of staple foods, rather than relying solely on a single cost-effective option.

Each player has an independent consumption count for each type of food, which decays every 10 in-game minutes. Based on the current count, various configurable effects can be applied (eating speed multiplier, health restoration or deduction, hunger and saturation adjustments).  Rarity Fragments

 Rarity Fragments are generated by deconstructing this gear inside the
 Salvage Inventory ,
 which by default can be opened with the R key.

funky-fluids:
Funky Fluids is a mod that adds various fluids with interesting and weird properties.

 

This is a list of all the fluids it adds:
 Oobleck
A non-newtonian fluid that increases in viscosity the more force you apply to it. If you approach it slowly, it will behave as a liquid, but if you impact it with a lot of force, it will behave as a solid. This means that you can run and jump on it without sinking into it.
 Liquid Crystal
It flows like a liquid but it behaves like a solid when you touch it. This means that you can stand on it.
 Melonade
A delicious drink made of watermelon and sugar.
 Silly Putty
Similar to oobleck but it's also bouncy, which is of course an improvement.
 Redstone Suspension
A suspension of redstone in water, it emits a constant redstone signal with the strength depending on the level of the fluid.
 Magnetroleum
A liquid that pulls entities in the opposite direction

World generation integration for KubeJS. Allows for the addition of configured features, placed features, and biome modifiers using KubeJS's ServerEvents.registry 

Supports:
- All vanilla configured feature types (+ a WorldJS custom type)
- All vanilla placement modifier types (+ placed features)
- All NeoForge biome modifiers

Additionally, support for other placement modifier types can be added with the provided PlacedFeatureModifierEvent 

 Example

 js
ServerEvents.registry('worldgen/configured feature', event = {
 event.create('delta feature', 'delta feature')
 .size([11, 15])
 .rimSize([1, 3])
 .rim('minecraft:calcite')
 .contents('minecraft:lava')
 .withPlacement('minecraft:delta', p = { // Overwrite the vanilla placed feature
 p.modifiers(modifiers = {
 let { minecraft } = modifiers
 minecraft
 .countOnEveryLayer(40)
 .biome()
 })
 })
})

BlockRandomizer – Global Block Drop Randomizer
 BlockRandomizer is a lightweight plugin/mod project that transforms every Minecraft world into a unique random‑drop gamble. Every block type generates a fixed, seed‑dependent item — meaning that on one world seed, stone might always drop diamonds, while on another seed it could consistently drop iron swords. The result is a fully reproducible randomizer experience where every world becomes its own puzzle.

Unlike traditional random‑drop projects, BlockRandomizer ensures that every block always drops the same item, no matter how often or where it is broken. no-clearchat-on-reconfigure:
The Problem
Minecraft 1.20.2 has added a configuration phase where the server can reconfigure several features for the client. Unfortunately when entering this configuration phase the clients chat is cleared and the server can not prevent that.

This is also relevant on multi server networks where switching between server causes the client to enter this configuration phase and so the chat is also cleared.

As is it often important to be able to follow conversations from before the reconfiguration this chat clear might be unwanted.

 The Solution
This mod just prevents Minecraft from clearing the chat messages when entering the configuration phase, so it will just behave like in older versions and you are still able to read what was written in the chat before.

 Known Incompatibilities 
None

Distant Decorations

 
 
 
 

 Distant Decorations is a high-performance Fabric framework for Minecraft 26.2 that lets participating mods persist and render decorative block-entity visuals far beyond vanilla chunk distances. Its default client subscription range is 512 chunks (8,192 blocks), with a server-authoritative maximum of 1,024 chunks (16,384 blocks). Integrations such as Fast Paintings and Camerapture provide their own lightweight server metadata providers and distant client renderers.

realplayer:
RealPlayer
Disables every fake player check in every mod

 TL;DR
It allows using existing automation (for example mob mashers) to automate things that would normally require a player kill (for example apotheosis gems)

 Details
Certain mods have checks for "FakePlayer"s. FakePlayers are for example, what mob mashers use to ensure you get player-only loot drops. Of course, many other things use fakeplayers.
Now, here's the issue: certain mod authors don't want fake players to produce drops from their mod. So if you use a mob masher for example, you won't be able to get their player-only drops. This mod fixes that, because by disabling fake player checks, we make every mod treat any fake player as if it was real.

If you would like to change the config, check the wiki link!

 If there are any issues, please report them in the github.

Create: Redstone Throttle

 

A compact Create kinetic controller driven by redstone signals.

 What it does

Redstone Throttle sits in a Create transmission and controls the output speed from
two independent redstone inputs. The red face increases speed, the blue face
decreases it, and the side arrow shows the direction from kinetic input to output.

- Place it on any of the six axes.
- Rotate the redstone control faces around the shaft axis with a wrench.
- Configure it in-game by holding Shift and right-clicking.
- Inspect live input, output, and settings with Engineer's Goggles.
- Use an adjustable update interval from 10 to 200 ticks (0.5–10 seconds).
- Keep Create's native stress and overstress behavior.

 Control modes

 Follow signal strength

Output speed follows the difference between the red and blue signals.

 Fixed speed

Outputs a configured target speed whenever a valid ki

 json

}
 

 Command

 Server Command

- /mana subtract Subtract mana supply. Returns modified mana supply in point.

A lightweight Minecraft mod for saving chat logs in a readable format with minimal interference to the base game.

 Inspiration

A lightweight client-side mod that displays server information in the pause menu when connected to a multiplayer server.

 Features

- Server name and MOTD display
- Server icon/favicon support
- Real-time ping indicator with visual status
- Player count information
- Works with both saved servers and direct IP connections
- Automatically adapts to different GUI scales
- Non-intrusive panel design that doesn't block menu buttons

 How it works

When you press ESC while playing on a multiplayer server, a panel appears showing all relevant server information. The mod automatically fetches server data for direct connections, ensuring you always see accurate information regardless of how you joined the server.

'Items, Begone!' is a utility mod for server admins that allows them to control what items are allowed to be used in a Minecraft server.

A core design feature of IBG is its team-based approach, allowing you to create advanced rulesets for individual groups of people, or, if you'd like, the entire server as a whole via the autogenerated 'global' group, all while using Minecraft's built-in Team system! And, thanks to its ID checking system, it should be compatible with almost, if not all other mods!

IBG also runs almost entirely server-side, meaning your server can be regulated regardless of what mods are present on your players clients, though additional features for clients with the mod are planned in the near future!

(Unofficial) Apothic x Point Blank Compatibility

A NeoForge (Minecraft 1.21.1) compatibility bridge that brings Point Blank's guns into Apotheosis' loot and gem system, so firearms can be affixed, socketed, reforged, and enchanted the same way melee weapons and bows already are.

 

 Features
- Guns can now have Rarities. Can reforge weapons to add affixes and sockets. 
- Splits guns into weapon classes. Shotguns, snipers, launchers, and small arms are tagged separately so affixes and gem bonuses can be tuned per class instead of applying identically to every gun. Currently this is done manually, but should support datapacks. 
- Adds Apotheosis gem bonuses to guns. Existing Apotheosis gems (e.g. Breach, Tyrannical, Inferno, Molten Breach) gain an extra bonus entry scoped to guns of different classes
- Adds gun-specific affixes. New prefix/suffix affixes exclusive to guns, based on class

potion-effects-set:
Potion Effects Set

Datapack-driven item potion effects, set bonuses, Curios support, and loot table injections.

This project exists in two versions:

- Forge 1.20.1 
- NeoForge 1.21.1 

Both versions share the same core idea and almost the same datapack workflow, so pack makers can use one system across both branches.

 What The Mod Does

With this mod, you can:

- give passive effects while an item is equipped
- give on-hit effects when the player attacks
- give on-hurt effects when the player takes damage
- target one item, many items through tags, or special variants through nbt 
- create tiered sets such as 2-piece, 3-piece, and 4-piece bonuses
- count Curios pieces, including duplicate accessories such as two matching rings
- inject custom rewards into existing loot tables without replacing them

 Versions

 Forge Version

- Loader: Forge 
- Minecraft: 1.20.1 
- Branch/mod: Potion

This lightweight optimization modpack utilizes Vulkan instead of OpenGL as the rendering engine. Due to this, some well-known optimization mods like Sodium couldn't be included, and shaders are not supported (for now). However, it still provides a significant FPS boost while maintaining the vanilla gameplay experience.

For players who prefer a pure FPS boost without additional quality-of-life improvements, check out the "Vulkan Plus" modpack.

Please note that this modpack will only be updated for the latest version the Vulkan mod supports. Older versions will not receive further updates.

 

 FAQ 

 What are the requirements to run this Modpack? 

 You need a GPU that supports at least Vulkan 1.2. To check if your GPU supports Vulkan, run "vulkaninfo" in a terminal or command prompt.

 Which graphics cards support Vulkan 1.2? 

 AMD: Radeon RX 400 series and newer
 Nvidia: GeForce GTX

Wanderlust Beacons

A datapack that spawns mysterious stone obelisks at the boundaries between explored and unexplored terrain.

 Spawning Mechanics

When a player enters a chunk adjacent to unvisited areas, there is a chance an obelisk will rise from the ground in a nearby unexplored chunk. The obelisk spawn is marked by rising amber particles visible from considerable distance.

 Structure Design

Obelisks are composed of deepslate and copper blocks in a simple spiral formation, topped with a lightning rod that occasionally sparks. They serve as natural waypoints for navigation.

 Decay System

Each obelisk tracks how long players spend in its chunk vicinity. Once a player has lingered within a 3-chunk radius for a cumulative five minutes of real time, the obelisk begins deteriorating block by block until nothing remains.

 Generation Limits

The generation logic prevents obelisk spam

sensible-biomes:
Sensible Biomes attempts to fix some of the most disliked features of vanilla world generation without taking away the vanilla feel: no new structures or weird trees, but a much better arrangement of what vanilla already offers.

- 72 new biomes help transitioning between vanilla ones (instead of hard borders where everything changes in a matter of a few blocks) and adding variety to biomes that only come in 1-2 versions in vanilla
- smooth transitions between 7 different climate zones and vegetation types (instead of random "biome bubbles" made of plains turning into forests turning into plains forever until boom! desert) 
- mostly flat beaches   (instead of sand climbing up hills) 
- beaches, caves and mountain peaks in many different materials (instead of just sand or random stone splotches)
- larger biomes, but not as large as Large Biomes mode
- smoother terrain and less caves swiss

Sensible Biomes试图在不带走原版感觉的情况下修复原版世界一代最不喜欢的一些特征：没有新的结构或奇怪的树，而是对原版已经提供的东西进行了更好的安排。 - 72个新的生物群系有助于在原版生物群系之间过渡（而不是硬边界，在那里一切都在几个街区内发生变化），并为原版中只有1 - 2个版本的生物群系增加多样性 - 7个不同气候带和植被类型之间的平滑过渡（而不是由平原变成森林，永远变成平原，直到繁荣!沙漠） - 大部分是平坦的海滩 （而不是沙子爬上山） - 海滩，洞穴和山峰在许多不同的材料（而不仅仅是沙子或随机的石头斑点） - 更大的生物群系，但不像大型生物群系模式那么大 - 平滑的地形和较少的洞穴瑞士

- EMF Keyframe Exporter converts Blockbench keyframe animations into Entity Model Features (EMF) expressions for OptiFine Custom Entity Models.

 Features
- Export position, rotation, and scale keyframes as EMF animation expressions.
- Preserve Linear, Step, Smooth (Catmull-Rom), and Bézier keyframe interpolation modes.

- Optionally export each animated target through a named var. variable.
- Choose entity-state triggers, including is riding, is sitting, and is sprinting, or use walking animation timing.
- Use Idle timing or the detected is falling trigger.
- Select Loop, Play Once, or Hold on Last Frame playback.
- Combine multiple Blockbench animations into randomly selected EMF animation variations.

About

 Stylecraft is a resource pack that focuses on using real world surfaces to create LabPBR textures for Minecraft Shaders. It can be used without Shaders, but you won't get the full visuals.

Every texture starts out from finding a surface to capture with a Digital Camera and processed through various programs to create seamless materials. Colors are adjusted to closey match the feel of the vanilla textures.

Parallax Occlusion is available on some of the textures, but due to how Connected Textures work you get raised edge on the corners of the blocks.

Fabric-API & Continuity are required to view the textures as they were designed.

lazy-striders:
Baby striders riding adults used to stay warm as long as the parent is in lava. 
But this was changed in 1.19.4, and now striders riding other striders are always cold. And apparently, this was an intentional change (see MC-189383 and MC-260630). Isn't that sad?

 Introducing: Lazy Striders!

Because it hurts me to see baby striders all sickly and purple, I made this small pack that makes all cold striders only slightly less red, and have closed eyes to give them a lazy look. This way, baby striders riding parents have a cuter, sleepy appearance instead of looking like they're minutes away from death's door!

Additionally, Lazy Striders - Illuminated is an alternate version of the pack that also retextures warm striders, making them look like they're illuminated by the lava below them. (This was inspired by how lit candles have unique textures)

This Resource/Shader
makes players and player heads blink. It's a small animation of the eyes closing and opening, driven by a built-in lightweight AI. The shader scans skins using algorithms to detect eye positions and applies the blinking effect accordingly.

Since it's based on neural-like pattern detection, it may sometimes make mistakes — blinking might not always align perfectly, especially on complex or heavily customized skins.

 Detection accuracy:

Simple skins: ~80% 

Custom skins: ~46% 

Complex skins: ~4% 

Despite its simplicity, this resource pack is ready for use in projects. I plan to improve eye recognition accuracy and make the blinking animation smoother and more natural in the future.

What is the R-T-S Shader?
It is a shader pack that attempts to simulate complex global illumination techniques. Unlike traditional shaders that rely on simple rasterization, R-T-S calculates light paths more realistically within the game engine.

Key Features
Global Illumination: Light bounces off surfaces to illuminate areas without direct sunlight (such as caves or building interiors), effectively eliminating flat, pitch-black shadows.

Real-Time Ray Tracing: It calculates light paths to create soft shadows (penumbras) that change size based on the distance from the light source.

Realistic Reflections (Screen Space Reflections): Surfaces like water, metal, or polished blocks accurately reflect their surroundings, including the sky, clouds, and nearby blocks.

Dynamic Atmosphere: Features atmospheric scattering, volumetric fog, and "god rays" (light beams piercing through trees or clou

什么是R-T-S Shader？ 它是一个着色器包，试图模拟复杂的全局照明技术。与依赖简单光栅化的传统着色器不同，R-T-S在游戏引擎中更真实地计算光路。 关键特征 全局照明：光线从表面反射，照亮没有阳光直射的区域（如洞穴或建筑物内部），有效地消除了平坦的漆黑阴影。 实时光线跟踪：它计算光路以创建软阴影（半影），这些阴影的大小会根据与光源的距离而变化。 真实反射（屏幕空间反射）：水、金属或抛光方块等表面准确地反射其周围环境，包括天空、云和附近的方块。 动态大气：具有大气散射、体积雾和"上帝射线"（光束穿透树木或云）的功能。

iron-moddetector:
ModDetector

 Packet-level cheat mod detection for Minecraft servers. Identifies disallowed client modifications using a translation key exploit — without any client-side agent.

 
 
 

---

 How it works

The plugin exploits Minecraft's sign editing flow to probe the client's translation table. If a mod is installed, it replaces translation keys with its own strings — betraying its presence.

 Detection flow (at connection time): 

1. A BlockUpdatePacket is sent to place a virtual sign near the player
2. An OpenSignEditorPacket is sent, opening the sign editor on the client
3. A SignUpdatePacket is sent containing the mod's translation key as the sign text
4. The client echoes the sign content back — if the value differs from the default fallback, the mod is present

 The entire handshake is invisible to the player and occurs silently at connection time. No GUI is shown, no chat message

• Embedded HTTP server inside the plugin
• Secure API key authentication (Bearer token)
• Fully configurable endpoints in config.yml 
• Field-level data toggles per endpoint
• Optional Vault economy support
• Rate limiting per IP
• Optional IP whitelist
• Bind to localhost for extra security
• Async-safe execution
• Clean architecture & scalable codebase
• JSON responses for easy integration

 ✦ Supported Endpoints

All endpoints can be enabled or disabled individually.
